title: Spec-Driven Development with Kiro IDE: Building AI-Aligned Software Through Living Specifications
summary:
As Artificial Intelligence becomes increasingly capable of generating code, the challenges of software development are shifting from writing code to defining requirements, managing complexity, maintaining control, and ensuring that AI-generated solutions align with human intentions.

Spec-Driven Development (SDD) introduces a structured approach in which specifications become the central source of truth, guiding AI agents throughout the software development lifecycle.

In this presentation, Haim Michael explores how Kiro IDE, Amazon's agentic development environment, supports Spec-Driven Development and enables developers to build reliable, maintainable, and AI-aligned software.

The presentation covers several key topics:

The End of Code-First Development: Understanding why AI-generated code shifts the bottleneck from implementation to specification, coordination, and verification.

The Limitations of Prompt-Driven Development: Exploring why relying on individual prompts makes it difficult to preserve intent, trace decisions, and maintain consistency.

Spec-Driven Development: Using living specifications to capture requirements, constraints, architecture, and acceptance criteria.

Kiro IDE and Its Ecosystem: Introducing Kiro IDE, CLI, Web, Mobile, and Crew.

The Development Process: Moving from steering documents and EARS-based requirements to technical design, implementation tasks, and AI-assisted execution.

Agent Hooks: Automating recurring activities such as code reviews, security checks, testing, formatting, and documentation.

Subagents and Parallel Execution: Delegating specialized tasks to AI agents and executing independent development tasks concurrently.

Kiro Workflows: Orchestrating complex, multi-step development processes using sequential tasks, parallel agents, and iterative loops.

Cloud-Based AI Agents: Enabling autonomous agents to handle long-running activities, monitoring, incident response, code reviews, and recurring tasks.

Persistent Orchestration and Observability: Using Kiro Crew to coordinate ongoing activities while maintaining visibility into agent execution, approvals, and results.

Best Practices: Keeping specifications updated, maintaining detailed steering documents, reviewing technical designs, optimizing AI capabilities through MCP servers, Skills, and Powers, and choosing the appropriate level of orchestration.

The central message is that the future of software development is not about generating more code. It is about defining intent precisely, orchestrating AI agents effectively, and maintaining control over the entire development process.

As code generation becomes increasingly inexpensive, software developers move to a higher level of abstraction, focusing on architecture, requirements, constraints, quality assurance, and coordination.

Living specifications become the foundation that keeps humans and AI agents aligned, enabling software systems to evolve without losing their original intent.

About the Speaker

Haim Michael is the Founder and CEO of Zindell Technologies, a software architect, author, university lecturer, and technology trainer with more than 25 years of programming experience. He is also a Kiro Ambassador, AWS Community Builder, and Oracle ACE Associate.

Website: https://blog.lifemichael.com

「Kiro IDE」を用いた仕様駆動開発（SDD）は、生きた仕様書を基盤にAIエージェントを指揮し、意図と整合性の取れたソフトウェア開発を可能にします。

title: Software Developers Evolution in the Era of AI
summary:
Artificial Intelligence is fundamentally transforming software development. As AI becomes increasingly capable of generating code, software developers' roles are shifting from writing code to designing systems, defining requirements, making architectural decisions, and orchestrating AI agents.

In this presentation, Haim Michael explores the skills, mindsets, and professional capabilities developers need to remain relevant and thrive in the AI era.

The presentation covers several key topics:

English Proficiency and Specifications: Why clear communication, precise requirements, and specification-driven development are becoming essential.

T-Shaped Professionals: The growing importance of combining deep technical expertise with broader interdisciplinary skills.

AI as a Development Partner: Moving beyond traditional coding toward collaborative development with AI.

Mental Models: Prioritizing fundamental concepts such as state, flow, abstraction, composition, and trade-offs over memorizing syntax and APIs.

Writing and System Design: Developing the ability to translate human intent into clear requirements, design system architectures, and establish boundaries.

Debugging and Code Review: Understanding, evaluating, and verifying AI-generated code while maintaining responsibility for software quality.

Becoming System Builders: Expanding beyond programming to understand business requirements, product development, and UI/UX considerations.

Continuous Self-Learning: Navigating rapidly evolving technologies, prioritizing learning objectives, and using AI as a personal learning accelerator.

The central message is that the future of software development is not simply about writing code faster. It is about moving to a higher level of abstraction, where developers define what needs to be built, understand why it matters, and guide AI systems toward reliable outcomes.

As generating code becomes increasingly inexpensive, software developers' real value shifts toward critical thinking, architectural understanding, clear specifications, continuous learning, and the ability to orchestrate the software development process.

About the Speaker

Haim Michael is the Founder and CEO of Zindell Technologies, a software architect, author, lecturer, and technology trainer with more than 25 years of programming experience. He teaches advanced computer science topics at universities and actively contributes to the international software development community.

title: 悩み深き管理職、部下育成の相棒はAI　活用模索するオムロン、JTB、セガサミー (人的資本の現場から)

ja_summary:
・部下の育成や動機付けに悩む管理職が増加している。

・AIを相談相手（壁打ち）として活用し、管理職の負担軽減を目指す企業が増加中。

title: 防衛テック新興、前年2.3倍の211億ドル調達　デュアルユース化で日本勢にも好機 (Business Intelligence)
source: 日経ビジネス 最新
summary: 世界の主要な防衛スタートアップの資金調達が急拡大している。スタートアップ投資データベース事業を手掛け、日経BPが出資するZuvaによると、調達額は2026年は既に211億ドル（3兆3000億円）と、25年通年の2.3倍となり、過去最多を更新。調達額は10年でおよそ220倍に増えた。防衛装備品へのAI搭載などが進むほか、製造分野でもドローンなどの生産が伸びている。著名投資会社が日本に進出するなど、国内新興への大型投資の期待も高まりつつある。
ja_summary:
・世界の防衛スタートアップへの投資が急拡大し、2026年の調達額は過去最多の211億ドルに到達。
・AI搭載やドローン増産など、軍民両用（デュアルユース）技術の進化が投資をけん引。
・著名投資家の日本進出も相次いでおり、国内防衛スタートアップへの大型投資にも期待が高まる。

ja_summary:

title: ドローン需要10倍を機にロボットも、独自コイルで高効率を実現
source: 日経クロステック 総合
summary: 独自構造の高密度モーターを強みとするアスター（秋田県横手市）が、米国中心に10倍以上へ膨らむドローン需要を狙う。2027年夏に新工場を立ち上げ、2028年度には現在の約20倍のモーター増産を見込む。鍵となるのが、東京大学発スタートアップの燈（あかり、東京・千代田）だ。燈はアスターに数十億円を出資し、フィジカルAI（人工知能）をアスターの工場に導入する。
ja_summary:
・秋田のモーターメーカー「アスター」がドローン需要増に向け、2028年度に生産能力を20倍へ拡大。
・東大発AI企業「燈」が数十億円を出資し、工場へのフィジカルAI導入を主導。
・独自技術のモーターとAI生産技術を組み合わせ、グローバル市場での競争力を強化する。

title: 専用製品開発でしのぎ削る軸受大手、Sim2Realとの「ギャップ」埋めに勝機
